questions.question: At which ground did Jennifer Hall record their career-best bowling figures (3-18, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval, against Tuskers on 2019/02/23.

questions.question: At Potchefstroom Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Lizri de Villiers holds it with 15, a joint record shared with Nthabiseng Nini.

questions.question: Shabnim Ismail's first and most recent appearances in this database are separated by roughly how many years?
questions.explanation: Ismail debuted in October 2005 and was still playing as recently as March 2026, just over 20 years apart.

questions.question: At which ground did Badgers record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground — largest win by runs of 332, against Kei on 2018/11/17.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Lions or Eastern Storm?
How many 100+ scores separate the all-time #1 (Lizelle Lee) and #2 (Annelie Minny) century-makers (combined T20 + List A) in the 13/14 season?
questions.explanation: Lizelle Lee: 2 — Annelie Minny: 1 — a gap of 1.
